title: Technology Sector Update for 10/01/2018: XNET,CVON,MAXR
text:

Technology stocks were firming to start the new week, month and quarter in pre-market activity Monday.
Among technology stocks likely to move on news:
(-) Xunlei ( XNET ) was slipping in early Monday pre-market activity, falling over 2%, after the cloud-based technology acceleration company earlier said it has signed an agreement with Beijing LinkChain Co Ltd for the transfer of exclusive rights to operate its LinkToken program outside the Chinese mainland. Moving forward, Xunlei will instead focus on becoming a dedicated provider of the underlying blockchain technology and infrastructure in addition to leveraging its shared computing and blockchain technology for potential business customers.
In other sector news:
(=) ConvergeOne Holdings ( CVON ) early Monday said it has purchased solutions integrator Advantel Networks for an undisclosed sum. ConvergeOne did not provide additional details about the transaction although the IT services company said the acquisition will boost its position as a provider of multivendor collaboration technologies, support and services.
(=) Maxar Technologies ( MAXR ) Monday morning said its SSL division was selected by NASA to work on two separate public-private partnerships to develop spacecraft technologies under the space agency's Tipping Point program to promote development of commercial space capabilities and benefit future NASA missions. A technology is considered by NASA to be at a tipping point if it is likely to produce commercial space applications and also represents a significant improvement in the ability to bring that technology to market.
